name: Lichtenburg
publicDescription: An artificial diplomatic city-state created by Lutwein and Kolreno on their shared border.
gmDescription: Starter city-state lore metadata only. No map, diplomacy engine or intelligence system is wired.

extraData.diplomacySummary: Diplomatic center where most treaties, conventions and black agreements are signed.
extraData.economySummary: Treaty work, diplomatic services, trade mediation and discreet agreements support the city.
extraData.loreSummary: Artificial city-state created by Lutwein and Kolreno on their shared border.

name: Bergenbi
publicDescription: A northern trade city-state moving goods between Kolymin and Lutwein.
gmDescription: Starter city-state lore metadata only. No map, diplomacy engine or intelligence system is wired.

extraData.diplomacySummary: Officially trades northern goods south and southern goods north.
extraData.intelligenceSummary: Good counterintelligence hides its role in weapon purchases.
extraData.economySummary: Trade route economy with covert military procurement under commercial cover.
extraData.loreSummary: Created by Kolymyn under Ostfront orders to buy Lutwein weapons and transfer them north and east.

name: Launtown

gmDescription: Starter city-state lore metadata only. No map, diplomacy engine or intelligence system is wired.

extraData.diplomacySummary: Officially a purchasing mediator and political advisor.
